_readme: Single source of truth for the narration. Edit text/pauses here, then run `npm run voice:scratch` (temporary synthetic voice) or `npm run voice:bill -- <recording>` (Bill's real voice). Both write public/audio/narration.wav, src/data/timing.json and public/captions/*. `clip` groups lines that are spoken in one breath; `pause` is the silence (seconds) placed after a line when it ends a clip; `slot` marks lines Bill says on camera. `rate` (words per minute) steers which synthetic take is kept; it has no effect on a real recording.

voice._note: TEMPORARY VOICE. An ElevenLabs library voice ('Jonathan - Warm Executive Narrator'), NOT Bill and NOT a clone of Bill. It exists only to time and present the film. Replace it with Bill's own recording (npm run voice:bill) before publishing, or confirm the ElevenLabs plan covers commercial use of library voices.
voice.speaker: Jonathan - Warm Executive Narrator
voice.takes: assets/voice/jonathan/{A,B,C,D}.mp3 — generated in four paragraphs from the script text, imported with: npm run voice:import

qwen_fallback.speaker: ryan
qwen_fallback.instruct: A mature, calm financial planner speaking to camera at a relaxed, measured pace. Low, warm and reassuring tone; sincere and thoughtful, like a quiet conversation across a desk.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Bill Badran. I'm a financial planner.
lines.cue: Open directly on Bill. Small lower third: BILL BADRAN / Financial Planner.

lines.text: And to me, a financial plan should start with something more important than numbers.
lines.cue: Stay on Bill. Slow push-in. No graphics.

lines.text: Your life.
lines.cue: CUT to cream field. Huge serif YOUR LIFE. A thin gold line draws beneath it. Hold the beat.

lines.text: The retirement you're looking forward to.
lines.cue: The gold line becomes a horizon; camera travels along it. A lakeside cottage and garden rise from the line.

lines.text: The people you want to take care of.
lines.cue: A table under a warm lamp; a family gathers around it.

lines.text: The freedom to do more of what matters to you.
lines.cue: A calendar with open days, a bicycle, a travel bag. Small label: WHAT MATTERS TO YOU?

lines.text: For more than fifteen years, I've worked with individuals and families to help them plan for goals like these.
lines.cue: Back to Bill, different framing. Quiet credential line: 15+ years · individuals & families.

lines.text: And I've noticed something.
lines.cue: Hold on Bill.

lines.text: People work hard.
lines.cue: The gold line returns as a life timeline. A pay stub lands on it.

lines.text: They save.
lines.cue: A savings account card lands further along.

lines.text: They try to make good decisions.
lines.cue: More small documents settle along the timeline. Nothing is wrong.

lines.text: But often, their financial lives have grown one piece at a time.
lines.cue: Objects keep accumulating, one by one, each a reasonable decision.

lines.text: A retirement account here.
lines.cue: Camera settles on one card: retirement savings, on its own cream island.

lines.text: An insurance policy there.
lines.cue: An insurance policy (dated 2009) on another island.

lines.text: A will that hasn't been reviewed in years.
lines.cue: A will, last reviewed long ago. Taxes and investments complete the set.

lines.text: Each piece may make sense on its own.
lines.cue: Each island gets a quiet check mark. The composition looks almost organised.

lines.text: But who's looking at how they all fit together?
lines.cue: PULL BACK: wide gaps between the islands. The gold line reaches toward them and stops short. WHO SEES THE WHOLE PICTURE? Hold.

lines.text: That's why I created The Guide to Financial Prosperity.
lines.cue: The line's end point swells into the guide's gold sun. Navy floods in; the cover assembles: sails, hull, moving water, title.

lines.text: To help you see the bigger picture — and take a clearer next step.
lines.cue: The cover settles as a page; the boat eases forward.

lines.text: Inside, we explore five common blind spots.
lines.cue: The guide's five numbered circles (teal, coral, gold, navy, purple). 5 COMMON BLIND SPOTS.

lines.text: Finances that are scattered, without one coordinated plan.
lines.cue: Circle 1 opens. Tiles scattered, the same one repeated. SCATTERED FINANCES.

lines.text: Focusing on returns without understanding fees and taxes.
lines.cue: Circle 2. An unlabelled return bar; fees and taxes peel away. WHAT ACTUALLY STAYS WITH YOU?

lines.text: Letting fear drive investment decisions.
lines.cue: Circle 3. A line falls; a cursor drifts to SELL and freezes. No recovery is drawn. DECIDE WITH A PLAN. NOT PANIC.

lines.text: Guessing what retirement will actually cost.
lines.cue: Circle 4. A tidy annual budget; travel, home repairs, family, health, the unexpected push it past the line. REAL LIFE DOESN'T FOLLOW A SPREADSHEET.

lines.text: And asking for advice after a major decision, when some options may already be gone.
lines.cue: Circle 5. Paper, signature line, pen approaching. It stops a millimetre short. BEFORE. NOT AFTER.

lines.text: They're easy mistakes to make, especially when nobody has shown you what to look for.
lines.cue: Slow down. Real pieces of the guide drift by: a question card, a story, a chart.

lines.text: So I've kept this guide simple.
lines.cue: The pieces settle into a clean row.

lines.text: Everyday examples.
lines.cue: A story card from the guide comes forward.

lines.text: Practical questions.
lines.cue: The guide's yellow question note comes forward.

lines.text: No complicated jargon.
lines.cue: The cover's 'Zéro jargon' pill.

lines.text: And at the end, five questions to help you look at your own situation.
lines.cue: Five question rows with empty circles. No scores.

lines.text: You don't need perfect answers.
lines.cue: The circles stay empty. Everything else clears away.

lines.text: You just need an honest starting point.
lines.cue: The five circles gather into one point. START WITH WHERE YOU ARE.

lines.text: That's how I approach financial planning, too.
lines.cue: Bill, briefly.

lines.text: We start with you:
lines.cue: THE CENTREPIECE. The point blooms into YOUR LIFE at the centre of the frame. Stillness.
lines.instruct: A mature, calm financial planner saying the most important line of the film. Slow and deliberate, warm and sincere, with a small breath before 'with you'. Low, reassuring tone.

lines.text: your family,
lines.cue: FAMILY appears close to YOUR LIFE, joined by a short gold arc.

lines.text: your priorities,
lines.cue: PRIORITIES.

lines.text: your goals.
lines.cue: GOALS.

lines.text: Then we look at the whole picture —
lines.cue: Pull back. The financial tiles are out there, still separate.

lines.text: your investments,
lines.cue: INVESTMENTS (teal) turns toward the centre.

lines.text: taxes,
lines.cue: TAXES (coral).

lines.text: insurance,
lines.cue: INSURANCE (gold).

lines.text: retirement,
lines.cue: RETIREMENT (navy).

lines.text: and estate planning —
lines.cue: ESTATE (purple).

lines.text: and build one coordinated plan.
lines.cue: For the first time the gold line connects everything, one organic loop around YOUR LIFE. The islands become one composition. ONE COORDINATED PLAN.

lines.text: A plan we revisit as your life changes.
lines.cue: The connected system rearranges (a child joins, a new home, retirement moves closer) and stays connected. The years tick by.

lines.text: My role is to help you understand your choices and how they connect to the future you want.
lines.cue: Bill. Hold. Almost no graphics.

lines.text: Take a few minutes to read the guide.
lines.cue: Bill, eye contact.

lines.text: And when you're ready, let's talk about what matters to you.
lines.cue: Bill, eye contact.

lines.text: You've worked hard for what you have.
lines.cue: Bill. Then a short beat as the frame turns navy.

lines.text: Let's build a plan for what comes next.
lines.cue: Navy. The gold line becomes the horizon, the sun rises, the sailboat moves across the teal water. A PLAN FOR WHAT COMES NEXT. Then name, READ THE FREE GUIDE, billbadran.com, French-only note, disclaimer.
